CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.broadcast_row_changes_to_user_topic()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$begin
  -- Build topic using user_id from NEW (or OLD for deletes if NEW is null)
  PERFORM realtime.broadcast_changes(
    'notifications-header:' || coalesce( (NEW->> 'user_id')::text, (OLD->> 'user_id')::text )::text,
    TG_OP,                 -- event
    TG_OP,                 -- operation
    TG_TABLE_NAME,         -- table
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,       -- schema
    NEW,                   -- new record (may be null for DELETE)
    OLD                    -- old record
  );
  return null;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.grant_default_party_newbie_badge()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_party_newbie_badge_id uuid;
begin
  select id into v_party_newbie_badge_id
  from public.badges
  where code = 'party_newbie'
  limit 1;

  if v_party_newbie_badge_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  insert into public.user_badges (user_id, badge_id, unlock_source, metadata)
  values (
    new.id,
    v_party_newbie_badge_id,
    'signup_default_badge',
    jsonb_build_object('reason', 'default_starter_badge')
  )
  on conflict (user_id, badge_id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_admin_invite_code_usage(p_owner_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_code_id bigint;
begin
  update public.admin_invite_codes
  set uses_count = uses_count + 1
  where owner_user_id = p_owner_user_id
    and not revoked
  returning id into v_code_id;

  return v_code_id is not null;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_badge_activity(p_user_id uuid, p_action_key text, p_points_delta integer DEFAULT 0, p_source_table text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_dedupe_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$declare
  v_id uuid;
begin
  insert into public.point_activity_events (
    user_id, event_type, action_key, points_delta,
    source_table, source_id, metadata, dedupe_key
  )
  values (
    p_user_id, 'activity', p_action_key, coalesce(p_points_delta, 0),
    p_source_table, p_source_id, coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb), p_dedupe_key
  )
  returning id into v_id;

  return v_id;
end;$function$
